baseline: Upstream KOReader v2026.07.1 (9192014d8), plus Kaia example and stickers plugins. Current plugin tree scanned on 2026-10-13

community.name: pencil.koplugin
community.reason: Stylus handwriting made for the Kobo Libra Colour. Keeps the original candidate.
community.workflow: Open an EPUB, enable Pencil, draw a stroke, erase it and reopen the book.
community.missing: Load stops at ReaderUI.active_widgets. Upstream also requires replacing frontend/device/input.lua. Needs app-owned stylus and eraser events, stroke storage, coordinate transforms and bookmark integration. The input replacement is not applied.

community.name: pagenotes.koplugin
community.reason: Page notes and stickers, including colour artwork. Keeps the original candidate.
community.workflow: Open a PDF, use Add note or sticker, type a text note, place it, finish editing and paint the page.
community.missing: Test adds text through the real dialog, checks stored host settings and changed page pixels, then turns a real PDF page and checks that the note disappears. Persistent arbitrary per-book settings need the app host. EPUB word anchors, sticker placement, dragging, rotation and colour output remain untested.

community.name: footcream.koplugin
community.reason: Converts unfamiliar measurements while reading. Provides a reading aid beyond timers and statistics.
community.workflow: Open an EPUB, scan its measurements and show one metric conversion at the matching text.
community.missing: Loads, then ReaderReady stops at document.findAllText. Needs document-wide search with xpointers, text geometry and reader paint/tap hooks. Its cache uses sidecars, and its in-text modes rewrite EPUB files. Those storage paths need an app-owned design before use.

community.name: anki.koplugin
community.reason: Exports dictionary words as study cards and can queue notes offline. Has 27 forks.
community.workflow: Open an EPUB, look up a word, choose Add to Anki and save one card to the offline queue.
community.missing: Load stops at dictionary:addToDictButtons because no dictionary host exists. Needs dictionary popup registration, lookup results, selection context and document metadata. Online AnkiConnect, translation and audio calls are excluded. Profiles are present under the scratch data/plugins/anki.koplugin path, so the test reaches the dictionary failure.

community.name: highlightsync.koplugin
community.reason: Merges annotations across devices. Has 236 stars and 21 forks, but its latest default-branch commit is older than the other candidates.
community.workflow: Open an EPUB with a host annotation, open Sync Cloud, then invoke Sync Highlights.
community.missing: The cloud settings widget opens. The main action stops at doc_settings.getSidecarDir before network access. The plugin writes JSON beside KOReader sidecars and replaces annotation.annotations without host writes. Needs a host-owned sync/storage adapter and stable annotation updates. Remote sync is excluded by the no-network product rule.

community.name: readingstreak.koplugin
community.reason: Tracks daily reading goals without a server. Adds a reading aid with persistent history.
community.workflow: Open an EPUB, turn a page, view the streak and calendar, then reopen the plugin.
community.missing: Checks one page increment, paints the streak and calendar widgets, and checks the saved streak after reopening. Time thresholds, day rollover, history import, and persistence of page totals after completing a daily goal remain untested.

community.name: bookends.koplugin
community.reason: Custom page text and progress overlays. The most popular selected plugin, with 500 stars and recent commits.
community.workflow: Open a PDF, enable Bookends through its menu, paint the default overlay, flush settings and reopen.
community.missing: Checks changed pixels and the plugin's own paint error counter before and after reopening. Tests the default preset on a grayscale frame. Advanced tokens, colour output, font packs, skimming, update downloads and preset sharing remain untested. The app must paint registered overlays.

community.name: readeck.koplugin
community.reason: Read-later articles, annotation export and library sync. Has 130 stars and 13 forks.
community.workflow: Open a book, configure Readeck and its download folder, then sync and open one article.
community.missing: Settings open. The sync action runs its scheduled callback and reports the missing server and download folder, with sync_in_progress cleared. Article download, authentication and export require server access, excluded by the no-network product rule. Successful transfer is not claimed.

community.name: foldermemory.koplugin
community.reason: Remembers sorting and display choices per library folder. A smaller candidate with an October commit.
community.workflow: In a library containing an EPUB, save a folder's sort/display settings, leave it and return.
community.missing: Library-mode load stops at FileManager.file_chooser. Reader-mode investigation also reached FileManager.onRefresh. The plugin patches Lua FileChooser and CoverBrowser. Needs app library adapters for sort, filters, display mode, grid size and folder entry/refresh. Lua class patches cannot change the Rust library view.

SSH.platform_basis: Loads only when a patched `dropbear` binary exists in the working directory (`main.lua` line 21). The Kobo branch mounts `/dev/pts` (line 75).
SSH.class_basis: Uses input and info dialogs and the standard container. No core patches or raw drawing.
SSH.workflow: Install the patched dropbear binary and enable the plugin. Set the SSH public key, start the server from its menu, and connect from a host. Change the force-close option, stop the server, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the key and options persist.

archiveviewer.platform_basis: No device checks in the code.
archiveviewer.class_basis: Uses the book list, text viewer and image viewer. No core patches.
archiveviewer.workflow: Enable the plugin. Open the file browser, open a zip file, view a text file and an image inside it, and extract one file to a folder. Suspend, resume, close and reopen the file browser, and confirm the extracted file is still there.
archiveviewer.data_note: Writes extracted files to the folder the user picks. Stores no settings.

autodim.platform_basis: Loads only when `Device:hasFrontlight()` is true (`main.lua` line 10). Libra Colour has a frontlight.
autodim.class_basis: Writes core frontlight state (`Powerd.fl_intensity`, `Powerd:setIntensity`) and runs its own idle timer.
autodim.workflow: Enable the plugin and set the idle time and dim percentage. Open a book, leave the device idle until the dimmer starts, and confirm the brightness drops. Touch the screen to restore it. Change the duration, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the values persist.

autostandby.platform_basis: Loads only on PocketBook (`main.lua` line 4). The Kobo check is commented out in that line.
autostandby.class_basis: Disabled by its own gate on Kobo.
autostandby.workflow: Not testable on Kobo. After a restart, confirm the plugin is listed as disabled and adds no menu entry.

autosuspend.platform_basis: Loads when `Device:canSuspend()` is true (`main.lua` line 5). Kobo has its own wait path (line 588).
autosuspend.class_basis: Uses the date-time and info widgets and public `Device` power calls. No core patches.
autosuspend.workflow: Enable the plugin and set the standby timeout to one minute. Open a book, leave the device idle, confirm standby, and resume with the power button. Change the suspend timeout, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the value. Test the power-off timeout last, because it shuts the device down.

autoturn.platform_basis: No device checks. The plugin uses the page timer and the UI event loop that every reader provides.
autoturn.class_basis: Uses the date-time and spin widgets. Shares a flag through `PluginShare`. No core patches.
autoturn.workflow: Enable Autoturn from the reader menu and set a 10 second timeout and a scroll distance. Open a book and wait for automatic page turns. Change the timeout, suspend, resume, confirm the timer continues, then close and reopen the book.

autowarmth.platform_basis: Warmth controls run only when `Device:hasNaturalLight()` is true (`main.lua` line 41). Libra Colour sets it in `frontend/device/kobo/device.lua` (KoboMonza).
autowarmth.class_basis: Writes core frontlight state (`Powerd.fl_was_on`) and hooks device and dispatcher events. The plugin is 1962 lines.
autowarmth.workflow: Enable warmth and night mode, set a schedule that starts within a few minutes, and open a book. Confirm the warmth and night mode change at the scheduled time. Change the night-mode setting, suspend, resume, confirm the warmth is restored, then close and reopen KOReader and check the saved schedule.

batterystat.platform_basis: No device checks in the code. It reads battery state through the device power API.
batterystat.class_basis: Uses the key-value page and the confirm dialog. No core patches.
batterystat.workflow: Enable the plugin and read a book for a few minutes. Open the battery statistics page, clear the statistics and confirm. Read again, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the page shows new samples.

bookshortcuts.platform_basis: No device checks. Shortcuts work through the standard gesture and dispatcher paths.
bookshortcuts.class_basis: Uses the file manager, path chooser and confirm dialog. No core patches.
bookshortcuts.workflow: Enable the plugin. In the file browser, add a shortcut to a folder and to a book, then bind a gesture to one shortcut. Trigger the gesture from the reader, delete one shortcut, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the remaining shortcuts.

calibre.platform_basis: The search code has a Kobo branch (`search.lua` line 29). The Android branch in `wireless.lua` line 185 does not apply on Kobo. Wireless use needs a calibre content server on the same network.
calibre.class_basis: Uses the book list, metadata and input dialogs. It requires reader and file manager modules but patches none.
calibre.workflow: Start a calibre content server on the same Wi-Fi network. Enable the plugin, enter the server URL and password, and send a book from calibre. Open the book, search calibre metadata from the reader, change the default format, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the settings persist.
calibre.data_note: Caches library lists and metadata in a `Persist` file and a `LuaSettings` file under the cache path (`main.lua` line 136).

cloudstorage.platform_basis: No device checks. Network calls go through the shared Wi-Fi manager, which Kobo devices use.
cloudstorage.class_basis: Uses 14 shared dialog, list and input widgets. No core patches.
cloudstorage.workflow: Add a test FTP or WebDAV server, enable the plugin, and browse it. Download one file, upload one file, and change the download folder. Suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the server list and folder setting persist.

coverbrowser.platform_basis: No device checks. It uses Blitbuffer drawing and the bundled SQLite binding, which the shared build includes.
coverbrowser.class_basis: Patches `FileChooser` with its own mosaic and list renderers and draws covers with Blitbuffer. It keeps a SQLite cache.
coverbrowser.workflow: Enable the plugin and open the file browser. Switch to mosaic mode, let the plugin index books, and check that covers appear. Change the grid size and display mode, open a book, and return to the browser. Suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and check the mode persists. Repeat in History and Collections.
coverbrowser.data_note: Writes `bookinfo_cache.sqlite3` and `cache/tmpcr3cache` under the data directory.

coverimage.platform_basis: Loads only on Android, the emulator, reMarkable or PocketBook (`main.lua` lines 9 and 10). Libra Colour matches none of them.
coverimage.class_basis: Disabled by its own platform gate on Kobo.
coverimage.workflow: Not testable on Kobo. After a restart, confirm the plugin is listed as disabled and adds no menu entry.

docsettingtweak.platform_basis: Registers its menu when `Device:isTouchDevice()` is true (`main.lua` line 21). Libra Colour is a touch device, so the menu appears.
docsettingtweak.class_basis: Uses the input dialog and the standard container. It hooks the `onDocSettingsLoad` event instead of patching a class.
docsettingtweak.workflow: Enable the plugin and open the directory defaults editor from the file browser. Add a tweak for a test folder, such as a font size. Open a new book in that folder and check the tweak applies on first load. Change the tweak, suspend, resume, close and reopen the book.
docsettingtweak.data_note: Reads `directory_defaults.lua` and copies its values into the book's settings when a new document first loads.

exporter.platform_basis: The My Clippings export runs only on Kindle (`main.lua` line 192). The history path runs on Kobo.
exporter.class_basis: Uses the reader highlight style lists and shared dialogs. Its export targets are separate modules under `target/`.
exporter.summary: Exports highlights and notes. The Joplin target is marked outdated in `_meta.lua`.
exporter.workflow: Open a book with highlights. Export highlights to Markdown and to JSON, choose a target folder, and check the files. Change the color filter, suspend, resume, close and reopen the book, export again, and confirm the files match the first export.

externalkeyboard.platform_basis: Loads only when an OTG role file exists (`/sys/kernel/debug/ci_hdrc.0/role` or `/sys/devices/platform/soc/usbc0/otg_role`) or on Kindle (`main.lua` line 103). Not verified on Libra Colour hardware (KR-002).
externalkeyboard.class_basis: Overwrites `Device` keyboard and key fields at run time and writes USB role files through sysfs and FFI.
externalkeyboard.workflow: Use a device that exposes an OTG role file. Enable OTG mode, connect a USB keyboard, and type in a search box. Disconnect and reconnect the keyboard, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the keyboard still works. Confirm the device does not stay in USB mass-storage mode.
externalkeyboard.data_note: Writes the OTG role through sysfs. This is device state, not user data.

gestures.platform_basis: Loads on touch devices (`main.lua` line 3). Libra Colour is a touch device with multitouch.
gestures.class_basis: Patches `GestureDetector` and `InputContainer` and records multiswipes from the input path.
gestures.workflow: Enable the plugin and open a book. Perform each default gesture, including corner taps and edge swipes. Change one gesture action, record a multiswipe, suspend, resume, close and reopen the book, and confirm the custom gesture still fires and the defaults are unchanged.

hello.platform_basis: `main.lua` line 9 runs `if true then return { disabled = true } end` before any other code. It is a developer template and loads in no shipped build.
hello.class_basis: Disabled on every platform. It is a developer template and is excluded from release tests.
hello.workflow: Not tested as a shipped feature. To test loader behavior, remove the block at line 9 in a local debug build and restore it afterwards.

hotkeys.platform_basis: Loads only with a screen keyboard or a physical keyboard (`main.lua` line 15). Libra Colour reports neither `hasScreenKB` nor `hasKeyboard`.
hotkeys.class_basis: Disabled by its own gate on Kobo.
hotkeys.workflow: Not testable on Kobo. After a restart, confirm the plugin is listed as disabled and adds no shortcut menu.

httpinspector.platform_basis: Runs on any device. The Kindle branches (`main.lua` lines 85 and 121) add firewall rules and do not run on Kobo.
httpinspector.class_basis: Uses the TCP server, input dialog and info message. It opens a network port when enabled.
httpinspector.workflow: Enable the plugin, set the port, and turn on auto-start. Start the server from the menu and request an object list from a browser on the same network. Stop the server, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the server stays off unless auto-start is set. Test only on a trusted network, because the plugin exposes internal objects.

japanese.platform_basis: No device checks. It works on any device with a dictionary installed.
japanese.class_basis: Uses the reader dictionary, spin widget and info message. It creates its own dictionary object and patches no core class.
japanese.workflow: Install a Japanese StarDict dictionary and enable the plugin. Open a Japanese book, tap and hold an inflected verb, and check the lookup uses deinflection. Change the text scan length, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the scan length persists.

keepalive.platform_basis: The Kobo branch at `main.lua` line 33 sets `PluginShare.pause_auto_suspend`. The disable branch at line 56 runs only on unsupported platforms, so Kobo keeps the plugin.
keepalive.class_basis: Uses the confirm and info dialogs and the standard container. Shares one flag with autosuspend through `PluginShare`.
keepalive.workflow: Enable Keep alive from the menu, open a book, and leave the device idle past the auto-suspend timeout. Confirm it does not suspend. Disable Keep alive, leave the device idle again, and confirm normal suspend. Suspend and resume manually, then close and reopen KOReader.
keepalive.data_note: Stores no settings. It changes the shared `PluginShare.pause_auto_suspend` flag at run time.

kosync.platform_basis: No platform gate. The device name comes from `Device.model`. Wi-Fi restore uses `hasWifiRestore`, which the Kobo base class sets. The Wi-Fi toggle check uses `hasSeamlessWifiToggle`, which the generic device class sets to true.
kosync.class_basis: Uses input, confirm and notification widgets and the shared HTTP client. Reads the document position through `self.ui.document`. No core patches.
kosync.workflow: Create a test account on a KOReader sync server and enable Progress sync. Turn on automatic sync, open a book, read a few pages, and close it. Open the same book on a second device or profile and pull the progress. Suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the page position.

movetoarchive.platform_basis: No device checks. It copies or moves book files with the file browser APIs.
movetoarchive.class_basis: Uses only the standard container and the confirm dialog. No core patches.
movetoarchive.workflow: Enable the plugin and set the archive folder. Open a book, copy it to the archive, and open it from the archive folder. Move a second book, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the archive folder setting persists.
movetoarchive.data_note: Copies or moves book files into the archive folder.

newsdownloader.platform_basis: No device checks. It uses the shared network manager and the file system.
newsdownloader.class_basis: Uses the key-value page, input dialog and multi-confirm dialog. Writes HTML files. No core patches.
newsdownloader.workflow: Enable the plugin and add a test RSS feed. Sync news feeds, open the news folder, and read one downloaded item. Change the image setting, sync again, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the feed list and setting persist.
newsdownloader.data_note: Writes HTML files to the news folder and a cache at `cache/newsdownloader.sqlite`.

opds.platform_basis: The Android branch sets the sync folder to the home directory (`opdsbrowser.lua` line 1669). Kobo uses the normal path.
opds.class_basis: Uses the menu, search, image viewer and text viewer widgets and the shared network manager. No core patches.
opds.workflow: Enable the plugin and add a public OPDS catalog. Browse it, search it, and download one book. Set the sync folder, sync the catalog, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the catalog list persists.

perceptionexpander.platform_basis: No device checks. The overlay draws over the page on any reader view.
perceptionexpander.class_basis: Overrides `paintTo` to draw two lines over the page with Blitbuffer, so it changes what the reader paints.
perceptionexpander.workflow: Enable the plugin and open a book. Check that the two vertical lines appear over the text. Change the margin, thickness and intensity, and turn pages. Suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the lines and settings persist.

profiles.platform_basis: No device checks in the code.
profiles.class_basis: Uses the date-time, spin, confirm and input widgets. Applies settings through the reader's settings API. No core patches.
profiles.workflow: Enable the plugin and create a profile from the current book's settings. Change the font size, execute the profile, and check the change. Turn on auto-execute, open a second book, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the profile list persists.

qrclipboard.platform_basis: Uses `Device:hasClipboard()`, which the generic device class sets to true.
qrclipboard.class_basis: Uses the QR message widget and the standard container. No core patches.
qrclipboard.workflow: Copy a short text inside KOReader, open the menu, and generate a QR code from the clipboard. Check that the code appears. Suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader.

readtimer.platform_basis: No device checks. It uses the standard UI timer and the dispatcher.
readtimer.class_basis: Uses the check button, date-time, input and notification widgets and registers dispatcher actions. No core patches.
readtimer.workflow: Enable the plugin and set an alarm for one minute. Open a book and wait for the alarm. Set a repeating interval and turn on the status bar timer. Suspend before the alarm is due, resume, and check that the timer continues. Close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the alarm state.

statistics.platform_basis: Color rendering depends on `Device:hasColorScreen()` (`main.lua` line 115). Libra Colour sets `hasColorScreen`, so the color path runs.
statistics.class_basis: Draws its own calendar and graphs with Blitbuffer (51 `Blitbuffer` or `paintTo` references), keeps reading data in SQLite, and hooks reader page events.
statistics.workflow: Enable the plugin and read a book for five minutes, turning pages. Open Reading statistics and check the time and page counts. Open the calendar view and the book view, and change the color rendering setting. Suspend, resume, close and reopen the book, and confirm the totals match.
statistics.data_note: Writes reading sessions to `statistics.sqlite3` under the settings directory. The exporter target reads the same file.

systemstat.platform_basis: The Kobo storage filter is set at `main.lua` line 26. The plugin reads battery and storage state through the device power API and one `io.popen` call.
systemstat.class_basis: Uses the key-value page and the standard container. Calls `io.popen` for one system query.
systemstat.workflow: Enable the plugin and open System statistics from the menu. Check the battery and storage rows. Leave the page open for a minute, close it, suspend, resume, reopen the page, and confirm the values update. Close and reopen KOReader.

terminal.platform_basis: The Kobo branch mounts `/dev/pts` (`main.lua` line 18). The plugin loads only when the pseudo-terminal check passes (line 50), so a missing `/dev/ptmx` disables it.
terminal.class_basis: Calls pseudo-terminal functions through FFI and runs shell commands through `os.execute`.
terminal.workflow: Enable the plugin and open the terminal. Run `ls` and `cat` on a test file. Change the shell path and font size, and run a command that prints many lines. Suspend, resume, close and reopen the terminal, and confirm the shell starts cleanly.

texteditor.platform_basis: No device checks. It uses the on-screen keyboard that Kobo devices show.
texteditor.class_basis: Uses input and text widgets and the document registry. No core patches.
texteditor.workflow: Enable the plugin and create a new file in a test folder. Type text, change the font and monospace setting, and save. Open a file from the history, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the file contents and settings persist.
texteditor.data_note: Writes plain text files that the user saves.

timesync.platform_basis: Runs only as root, and only when busybox `ntpd` or `ntpdate` exists (`main.lua` lines 10 and 28). The comment in `main.lua` says Kobo ships busybox `ntpd`. Not verified on hardware.
timesync.class_basis: Uses the info message, network manager and standard container. No core patches.
timesync.workflow: Confirm the device runs KOReader as root and has busybox `ntpd`. Enable Time sync, connect to Wi-Fi, and run Synchronize time. Check the displayed time against a known clock, then suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader.
timesync.data_note: Changes the system clock. It stores no settings.

vocabbuilder.platform_basis: Chooses the key layout with `Device:hasKeys()` and `Device:isTouchDevice()` (lines 80 and 89). Libra Colour has keys and a touch screen.
vocabbuilder.class_basis: Uses dictionary popup buttons and word-list widgets with custom colors. It adds buttons through the popup's button table, not by patching the class. No core patches.
vocabbuilder.workflow: Enable the plugin. Look up three words in the dictionary while reading, and open the vocabulary list. Add and remove a word, start a review session, and answer a card. Suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the words and review progress persist.
vocabbuilder.data_note: Writes `vocabulary_builder.sqlite3` and `lookup_history.lua` under the settings directory.

wallabag.platform_basis: No device checks. It uses the shared network manager and standard socket calls.
wallabag.class_basis: Uses the download manager and the document registry. No core patches.
wallabag.workflow: Configure a test Wallabag server and sync. Download one article, mark it read, and open it in the reader. Check the reading position, suspend, resume, close and reopen KOReader, and confirm the article status persists.

kaiaexample.platform_basis: The DISABLED_BY_DEFAULT gate in main.lua disables this extension API example.
kaiaexample.class_basis: Disabled developer example. Uses the Kaia extension API when enabled.
kaiaexample.workflow: Not assessed by the L5 bundled or community tests. In a debug build, enable the example, open its greeting menu, change the shout setting and invoke its command.

kaiastickers.platform_basis: No platform gate. Needs the Kaia library and store to add stickers to EPUB and PDF documents.
kaiastickers.class_basis: Registers a reader overlay and highlight button, writes stickers through the Kaia store, and uses engine positions and selection geometry.
kaiastickers.workflow: Not assessed by the L5 bundled or community tests. Open an EPUB and PDF, place a sticker and a text note, move and resize them, turn pages, export them and reopen the book to check storage.
kaiastickers.data_note: Stores stickers through frontend/kaia/store.lua. The Rust app integration is not assessed here.
